content.short: Spring provides labs to help businesses securely store and share sensitive data.
content.description: Founded in 2017, Spring enables businesses to securely store and share sensitive data, supporting risk management by reducing exposure to sensitive information and by elevating machine-learning powered insights that inform smarter decisions. Developers can access the Establish Trust and Identification function through Sybil-resistant DIDs and KYC/AML checks that are native to the on-chain environment, helping teams verify identities and assess risk within trusted data workflows.
